Computation (Python 3; imports json, subprocess, os; from tools import status as st, value as val):
es = [json.loads(l) for l in subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/main:log.jsonl'], text=True).splitlines()]
runs = json.load(open('transcripts/evidence/runs-tests-20261117T1010.json')) + json.load(open('transcripts/evidence/runs-tests-20261117T1010-historical.json'))
opening, start, end = st.c2a_window(es)
gate = st.attack_start(os.getcwd(), runs, end, 'tests/test_value.py')
assert gate is not None
assert st.instant(end) < st.dt.datetime.now(st.dt.timezone.utc)
v = val.value(es, as_of=end, attack_green=gate)
print('C2a window:', opening, start, end)
print('value attack-green:', gate, 'events:', v['events'])
print('window weights:', {k: str(w) for k,w in v['window_weights'].items()})
print('below base:', [k for k,w in v['window_weights'].items() if w < v['window_weights']['base']])
assert v['window_weights']['builder'] < v['window_weights']['base']
print('outcome: 1')
